meta.git: not a git checkout (tool_md5 identifies the tool)

requirements.title: Codepoint file naming, in Unicode 18.0
requirements.test: filename = lowercase hex codepoints joined by "-", FE0F dropped (except the 4 names Max kept: 1f3f3-fe0f-200d-1f308, 1f3f3-fe0f-200d-26a7-fe0f, 1f3f4-200d-2620-fe0f, 26d3-fe0f-200d-1f4a5); maps to a fully-qualified emoji-test 18.0 entry (plan/coverage.csv)
requirements.doc: File name must be the emoji's codepoint sequence, so it maps to exactly one Unicode emoji.

requirements.title: SVG and PNG both present
requirements.test: svg/<cp>.svg and png/<cp>.png exist and are non-empty

requirements.title: PNG canvas 512x512 RGBA
requirements.test: PIL: size == (512,512), mode RGBA, transparent background (corner alpha 0), art present

requirements.title: Valid square SVG
requirements.test: parses as XML, root <svg> in the SVG namespace with a square viewBox, renders with cairosvg

requirements.title: No live text
requirements.test: no <text>, <tspan>, <textPath> or font-family; lettering must be outlined paths (house rule no_live_text)

requirements.title: Self-contained SVG references
requirements.test: every url(#id) / href="#id" is defined in the file; no external http/file/data-font references

requirements.title: PNG is the render of the SVG
requirements.test: cairosvg 512px render of the SVG vs the PNG: <=0.5% of pixels differ by more than 48/255 in any RGBA channel

requirements.title: Covered by exactly one active lock
requirements.test: svg and png paths each appear in exactly one lock listed in qc/verify_locks.sh

requirements.title: Lock hash matches
requirements.test: md5 of svg and png equal the md5 recorded in the active lock

requirements.title: Outline width in the group range
requirements.test: check.metrics outline_px @512: yellow faces 8.55-12.45; non-yellow faces 4.875-14.625; PB hands 4-8; PB body parts 5-8 (house 6px); other People & Body 5-15; everything else 11-15 (house 13px). Toned files are measured tone-neutral (check.tone_neutral_outline: skin stops and the dark-tone inner contrast rim swapped for base colours, so dark skin is not counted as ink). n/a if no outline is measurable (outline_px 0)

requirements.title: Edge margin in the group range
requirements.test: check.metrics margin_min_px @512: country/subdivision flags 60-75 (by-design flag tile, 67); pennant flags 40-50 (47); full-bleed Symbols (tiles, keycaps, round signs: alpha box >=94% of the canvas) 2-8 (4); People & Body 12-60; yellow faces 13.15-37.85; non-yellow faces 0.25-136.75; everything else 12-45

requirements.title: House yellow face gradient
requirements.test: check.metrics yellow top/mid/bot hue, sat, val inside house-spec ranges (3rd-97th pct of the original art, widened 15%)

requirements.title: Gloss highlight position and size
requirements.test: gloss_x, gloss_y, gloss_area inside house-spec ranges

requirements.title: Eyes present and placed
requirements.test: eyes detected in the eye zone; eye_width_frac, eye_y_frac, eye_height_frac inside house-spec ranges

requirements.title: Mouth present and placed
requirements.test: mouth_width_frac, mouth_y_frac, mouth_height_frac inside house-spec ranges

requirements.title: Face diameter
requirements.test: face_diam_frac inside the house-spec range

requirements.title: Feature colours on the house palette
requirements.test: offpalette_frac (feature pixels farther than palette_max_dist from the 16-colour feature palette) <= house max

requirements.title: Colour count
requirements.test: distinct #rrggbb colours in the SVG inside the house-spec range

requirements.title: Highlights do not touch the outline
requirements.test: work/hlaudit.py (fixed outline mask, tool of record 2026-10-18) audit(svg,2) == 0 px; files on qc/hlaudit-known-exceptions.json with an unchanged md5 are KNOWN-EXCEPTION

requirements.title: Crescent mouths carry the shared mouth gradient
requirements.test: work/mouthbowl.pairs: every crescent-mouth bowl uses an mbowl-* gradient, unless its crescent is <60% visible (mouthbowl.crescent_visibility; covered by visor/hands/beard) -> that mouth is n/a

requirements.title: Eye rims present
requirements.applies: files using the house head art (template6 heads)
requirements.test: every head-art eye-rim gradient referenced (ids *_g459/_g460/_g492/_g493/_g441/_g442/_g409/_g410) is defined, so the rims render (families/03/04 frag-cache bug)

requirements.title: Headwear fits the head (hatfit)
requirements.applies: People & Body files with headwear codepoints (people_qc HEADWEAR) or data-hat markers
requirements.test: work/hatfit.check_svg: markers present and 0 violation px of head/hair above the band

requirements.title: Skeleton figures pass posecheck
requirements.test: work/posecheck.check_svg: every embedded skeleton inside the biomechanics ranges for its pose (qc/pose-validation.md)

requirements.title: Paired hands are matched
requirements.applies: figures with two or more house hands
requirements.test: all house-hand groups (people4 hand frame) in a file share the same scale and the same ink stroke width

requirements.title: Hand stroke consistent across skin tones
requirements.applies: house-hand figures that have tone variants
requirements.test: the hand ink stroke width equals the modal value of the same emoji across its base + 5 tone files

requirements.title: Skin tone correct
requirements.applies: People & Body (except no-skin emoji) and every file with a tone modifier
requirements.test: each tone named in the filename has its active-palette 4-stop skin gradient (qc/skin-tones.json) present (>=3 of 4 stops); no tone that is not named is present

requirements.title: Keycap shape
requirements.test: alpha silhouette IoU >= 0.97 against the keycap reference (majority vote of all keycaps)

requirements.title: Flag silhouette
requirements.test: alpha silhouette IoU >= 0.90 against the flag reference (majority vote of all country/subdivision flags)

requirements.title: Symbol tile shape
requirements.applies: Symbols drawn on a tile (art fills >=88% of a >=94% canvas box)
requirements.test: alpha silhouette IoU >= 0.97 against the symbol-tile reference
